mutation_targets.rationale: F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries is the sole structural guard preventing two AuditEntries from recording the same Operation (i.e., overwriting / duplicating a record). Clearing it removes the injectivity constraint on records_op; the injection forces two distinct AuditEntries to share a linked_operation, which is exactly the counterexample the AppendOnly and FR_010_AuditImmutable assertions must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.records_op = ae2.records_op }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_CareTeamGating enforces that a Permitted outcome on RecordsLookup requires an active care-team membership. Clearing it lets the model produce a Permitted Operation with no membership row. The injection forces exactly this state: a Permitted RecordsLookup whose caller has no Active membership for the target patient.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGatingViolation { some op: Operation | op.op_kind = RecordsLookup and op.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.member = op.caller and m.patient = op.target and m.mstatus = Active) }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_NoInformationLeakage is the sole fact that pins Denied and NotFoundOrDenied outcomes to Resp404NotFound. Clearing it lets the model produce a Denied operation with a different response shape (e.g., Resp200OK or a distinct error code), leaking the distinction. The injection forces a Denied operation to return something other than Resp404NotFound.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InformationLeakageViolation { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Denied and op.response != Resp404NotFound }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_LeastPrivilege enforces the closed-world permission matrix by constraining every Operation's (role, op_kind) pair to be in PermMatrix.Allowed. Clearing it allows an AuditOfficer to perform a RecordsLookup or a clinical role to perform an AuditSearch. The injection instantiates the most dangerous violation: an AuditOfficer reaching RecordsLookup.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | op.caller.role = RoleAuditOfficer and op.op_kind = RecordsLookup }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_AuditAttribution is the sole fact tying every AuditEntry's clinician, snapshotted_role, patient_ref, ae_outcome, and ae_auth_basis back to the Operation it records. Clearing it allows misattribution. The injection forces an AuditEntry whose snapshotted_role differs from the actual caller's role — a direct violation of the FR-009 snapshot requirement.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.snapshotted_role != ae.records_op.caller.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_AuditCompleteness is the primary fact guaranteeing that every non-503 Operation generates exactly one AuditEntry. Clearing it lets the model produce an Operation with response != Resp503Unavail and no corresponding AuditEntry — violating SC-001 ('100% of accesses audited'). The injection forces exactly this missing-audit state.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenesViolation { some op: Operation | op.response != Resp503Unavail and (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.records_op = op) }
